          - text: The HTML
          - code [ref=f159e246]: <input>
          - text: element is the most used form element.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e247]:
          - text: An
          - code [ref=f159e248]: <input>
          - text: element can be displayed in many ways, depending on the
          - code [ref=f159e249]: type
          - text: attribute.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e250]: "Here are some examples:"
        - table [ref=f159e251]:
          - rowgroup [ref=f159e252]:
            - row [ref=f159e253]:
              - columnheader "Type" [ref=f159e254]
              - columnheader "Description" [ref=f159e255]
            - row [ref=f159e256]:
              - cell "<input type=\"text\">" [ref=f159e257]
              - cell "Displays a single-line text input field" [ref=f159e258]
            - row [ref=f159e259]:
              - cell "<input type=\"radio\">" [ref=f159e260]
              - cell "Displays a radio button (for selecting one of many choices)" [ref=f159e261]
            - row [ref=f159e262]:
              - cell "<input type=\"checkbox\">" [ref=f159e263]
              - cell "Displays a checkbox (for selecting zero or more of many choices)" [ref=f159e264]
            - row [ref=f159e265]:
              - cell "<input type=\"submit\">" [ref=f159e266]
              - cell "Displays a submit button (for submitting the form)" [ref=f159e267]
            - row [ref=f159e268]:
              - cell "<input type=\"button\">" [ref=f159e269]
              - cell "Displays a clickable button" [ref=f159e270]
        - paragraph [ref=f159e271]:
          - text: "All the different input types are covered in this chapter:"
          - link "HTML Input Types" [ref=f159e272] [cursor=pointer]:
            - /url: html_form_input_types.asp
          - text: .

        - heading "Text Fields" [level=2] [ref=f159e278]
        - paragraph [ref=f159e279]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e280]: <input type="text">
          - text: defines a single-line input field for text input.
        - generic [ref=f159e281]:

        - separator [ref=f159e307]
        - heading "The <label> Element" [level=2] [ref=f159e308]
        - paragraph [ref=f159e309]:
          - text: Notice the use of the
          - code [ref=f159e310]: <label>
          - text: element in the example above.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e311]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e312]: <label>
          - text: tag defines a label for many form elements.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e313]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e314]: <label>
          - text: element is useful for screen-reader users, because the screen-reader will read out loud the label when the user focuses on the input element.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e315]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e316]: <label>
          - text: element also helps users who have difficulty clicking on very small regions (such as radio buttons or checkboxes) - because when the user clicks the text within the
          - code [ref=f159e317]: <label>
          - text: element, it toggles the radio button/checkbox.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e318]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e319]: for
          - text: attribute of the
          - code [ref=f159e320]: <label>
          - text: tag should be equal to the
          - code [ref=f159e321]: id
          - text: attribute of the
          - code [ref=f159e322]: <input>
          - text: element to bind them together.

        - heading "The Submit Button" [level=2] [ref=f159e394]
        - paragraph [ref=f159e395]:
          - text: The
          - code [ref=f159e396]: <input type="submit">
          - text: defines a button for submitting the form data to a form-handler.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e397]: The form-handler is typically a file on the server with a script for processing input data.
        - paragraph [ref=f159e398]:
          - text: The form-handler is specified in the form's
          - code [ref=f159e399]: action
          - text: attribute.
        - generic [ref=f159e400]:
